# thunder_network_virtual_wire_health_check (Resource)

`thunder_network_virtual_wire_health_check`: Virtual Wire Health Check Configuration

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vlan` (Number) VLAN ID, specify 1 for untagged traffic

### Optional

- `active_threshold` (Number) Threshold(Packet Per Second) for entering active mode
- `enable` (Number) Enable the health check
- `ethernet` (Number) Ethernet interface
- `garp_interval` (Number) Interval (Seconds), default is 3, 0 for interface event only
- `inner_vlan` (Number) inner VLAN for 802.1QinQ
- `inner_vlan_packet_count` (Number) Only count packets with configured inner VLAN ID
- `interval` (Number) Interval (Seconds), default is 3
- `l3_packet` (Number) Only count L3 packets
- `method` (String) 'ping': Ping; 'garp': GARP; 'packet-count': Packet Count;
- `nexthop_ip` (String) Nexthop address
- `nexthop_mac` (String) Nexthop mac address
- `partition_health_check` (Number) Health check state stands for the partition
- `sampling_enable` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--sampling_enable))
- `sby_ethernet` (Number) Ethernet interface
- `sby_trunk` (Number) Trunk interface
- `source_ip` (String) source ip for ping method
- `source_mac` (String) source mac for ping method
- `trunk` (Number) Trunk interface
- `user_tag` (String) Customized tag
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
